text_block_list.text:
First day of summer training camp. Wonder 
Acute eats her fill at the barbecue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have lost all awareness of 
conditioning her body for races. The 
options to boost her motivation... are 
already running out.
